stock_cdefs.note: The repository cdefs.lua contains 544 unique declarations; the often-quoted 531 is a version-dependent subset.

notes: The closure is conservative: a method name used through a dynamically typed receiver is matched against all stock wrappers with that method name.
A missing wrapper means either a helper/library method, a Repentance-only API, or userdata/metatable behavior implemented outside scripts_v2.
CustomHealthAPI/DSS are bundled mod code and require additional Lua-level compatibility, not just one native C symbol.
